steps: Open src/cli.ts in your code editor.
Review the current implementation of the terminal UI in cli.ts.
Identify areas where the UI can be improved, such as adding colors, formatting, or clearer prompts.
Implement changes to enhance the user interface, such as using a library like chalk for colors or inquirer for prompts.
Test the changes by running the CLI commands in the terminal to ensure the UI improvements are functioning as expected.
Make sure to handle any edge cases or errors gracefully in the UI.
Commit the changes to version control with a descriptive message.
